remarks: WELCOME to this distinctive semi-custom home ideally situated on one of the most sought-after streets in the heart of Yorba Linda. Set on a beautifully landscaped, nearly half-acre lot with mature trees and inviting park-like setting, this home offers gracious living with 4 bedrooms including 2 primary suites, 4 bathrooms, downstairs den, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Dramatic 2 story foyer with soaring ceiling, grand staircase, decorative-glass window and elegant chandelier creates a memorable first impression. Generous living areas include vaulted living room with marble fireplace, formal dining room, welcoming family room with brick fireplace, and versatile den with French doors
